stories.title: Define Map Provider Data Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the frontend contract for rendering providers on a map including latitude, longitude, provider name, specialty, and identifier. Ensure compatibility with existing provider search outputs.

stories.title: Implement Provider-to-Map Transformation Logic
stories.description: Transform provider search results into map-ready marker objects including coordinate validation, deduplication, and fallback handling for missing geo data.

stories.title: Render Interactive Map with Provider Markers
stories.description: Implement frontend map component to display provider markers, support zoom/pan, and show provider summary on marker click.

stories.title: Integrate Map with Provider Search Results
stories.description: Bind map rendering to provider search results so that map updates dynamically based on user queries and search filters.

stories.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating marker rendering, coordinate handling, user interaction (click/zoom), and synchronization with provider results.
